sentences.en: The jury found that Samsung had infringed upon Apple's patents.
sentences.zh: 陪审团裁定三星侵犯了苹果的专利。

sentences.en: Ok, everyone has left to go file a patent!
sentences.zh: 好的，大家都出去申请专利吧！

sentences.en: A patent right is an important property right.
sentences.zh: 专利权是一项重要的财产权。

senses.zh: 专利；专利 权；专利品
